title: Freeze regression inputs
responsibility: Keep test inputs fixed between the failing-test commit and its fix.

inputs.name: testPath.path
inputs.description: A repository-relative path classified as a test when it contains a test, tests, e2e, fixtures, __tests__, or __snapshots__ segment followed by /, matches a .test. or .spec. filename pattern, or starts with specification/scenarios/. This is a pattern check and does not verify that the path exists.

inputs.name: metadata.path
inputs.description: A repository-relative path classified as metadata when it begins with specification/loops/ or ends with .md. Other paths return false.

inputs.name: regressionFiles.root
inputs.description: The repository root passed to the evidence-tree, unit-registry, and commit-tree readers. It must identify the repository containing the selected commit.

inputs.name: regressionFiles.commit
inputs.description: The commit identifier used to read the tracked evidence tree and unit manifests. This function does not validate its format itself.

inputs.name: regressionFiles.tests
inputs.description: A nonempty list of repository-relative paths naming strengthened tests. Each path must be tracked in the selected commit, cannot start with / or contain a .. segment, and cannot name manifest-owned product source unless testPath matches it.

inputs.name: regressionFixCommit.root
inputs.description: The repository root used to inspect the red checkpoint, candidate fix, and their tracked files. It must identify the repository containing both commits.

inputs.name: regressionFixCommit.commit
inputs.description: The candidate fix commit whose ancestry, changed files, and frozen regression inputs are checked. It must differ from and descend from the red record source commit.

inputs.name: regressionFixCommit.red
inputs.description: The regression record whose source commit, tests, and inputs form the baseline for comparison. The operation assumes it is the retained red record and does not validate its phase or status.

examples.assertion: The strengthened regression test fails before the fix.

inputs.name: regressionTestCommit.root
inputs.description: The repository root passed to GitAdapter for the candidate failing-test checkpoint. It must identify the repository containing the commit.

inputs.name: regressionTestCommit.commit
inputs.description: The commit whose diff against its first parent is checked for test-only changes. The function reads changed paths from commit^ to commit.

inputs.name: regressionTestCommit.tests
inputs.description: A list of repository-relative paths naming tests that the checkpoint must strengthen. At least one listed path must appear among the changed files; this operation does not validate the paths against the commit tree.

outputs.name: testPath
outputs.description: Returns true for paths matching the test, fixture, snapshot, test-filename, spec-filename, or scenario-prefix patterns; otherwise returns false.

outputs.name: metadata
outputs.description: Returns true for paths under specification/loops/ or paths ending in .md; otherwise returns false.

outputs.name: regressionFiles
outputs.description: Resolves to path-and-hash entries from the selected tracked evidence tree for the named tests, recognized test paths, and recognized runner configuration files. The entries are sorted by path.

outputs.name: regressionFixCommit
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after validating that the fix commit differs from and descends from the red source commit, preserves the red inputs exactly, and changes at least one product-code path.

outputs.name: regressionTestCommit
outputs.description: Resolves with no value when the commit changes only named tests, recognized test paths, or recognized metadata paths, and at least one named test changed.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the named tests are empty or invalid, when a failing-test commit includes disallowed changes or names no changed test, or when a fix commit is reused, does not descend from the red commit, changes frozen inputs, or lacks a product-code change.
